notes.title: One Year Anniversary of Tavern Talk 🥳
notes.content:
Welcome back Innkeepers


           [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/f19e36c7af4ba20908d5b34808bf276269dcaa59.jpg"]



We can't believe it ourselves, but exactly one year ago, we opened the doors to the Wayfarer's Inn and released Tavern Talk! 🎉 Our first entertainment game and a huge step for us. Even before that, we were, and still are, so grateful for all the love and support you all have given us. 💜



To celebrate the occasion, we bundled all our DLCs into one huge "Dragon's Hoard Edition"-Bundle. 🐉 Containing Tavern Talk, Tempest Tantrum, the Soundtrack, the Lorebook, the D&D One Shot, the Battle Maps and the Major Arcana Tarot Cards! 🔥Best of all, for a limited time, IT'S 50% OFF! 🤩 Our biggest discount yet! 



Check out the bundle right now!



Don't forget, if you already own one or more items, don't worry, because it's a "complete the set" bundle. This means that you only pay for the items you do not yet own. It's the perfect way to complete your collection! 💸 And as a special goodie on top, we also updated the Lorebook, and it now includes Oleander from the Tempest Tantrum DLC. 📖 This newest addition to the bundles is the 15th bundle we've made!



With that, I want to take the time to look back and give you some numbers about Tavern Talk and show you all the stuff we achieved thanks to you! 👀 So many of you are forever ingrained into the game with your name in the credits, because of your support during our two Kickstarters, you brought a piece of Tavern Talk into the real world with our Makeship campaign and stickers. So much wouldn't be possible without you. 🫶



Over the last year, we sold almost 80.000 copies (including Nintendo Switch) 💪, you all have written way over 1.400 reviews on Steam ✍️, won the Gamescom Award for most wholesome 2025 🏆, and were nominated for so many awards! 🥳 A couple of months after the release, we gave you the story DLC Tempest Tantrum, introducing a new three-hour-long story, a new character, familiar and drink!🍸 



We have had 16 patches on Steam. Including smaller bug fixes and improvements like sound effect implementations, ambient sounds, achievement fixes, and so much more!



Transparency and communication with our community are extremely important for us! And based on your feedback & suggestions that you've left in our Discord, Reviews, or Steam discussions, we tried to implement as much as we can into Tavern Talk. ✨



Let's dive in and see how much has changed since June 20th, 2024! 👉👈


Improvements


We had many improvements for Tavern Talk, ranging from big to small. Like general localization improvements for our different languages. If you caught a mistake or a more fitting phrasing in our game for your native language, we implemented this change as fast as we could, after consulting with our localization teams. They edited the English version to raise quality and translated Tavern Talk into Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, and German (yes, we didn't have the capacity and time to do that ourselves). 



We learned that sometimes less is more, and so we changed the frequency of the Swift Strike that was ordered a lot in the beginning. So much so that it even became a meme. 😅 



      [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/49f624b5e59e8d189f1f9a3f2f4c896d8af2539f.jpg"]



Another meme became the pooping bird in the background and while it still poops, it happens way less often now. 🐦‍⬛ That evil, evil bird...



For all the Streamers and Content Creators, we ensured that the game sound was still running in the background even if you tapped out of the game. That way, you can still enjoy the cozy tavern music! 🎶 This is not the only thing we implemented for Streamers, but more on that later when we take a look at the features!



One of the first big changes we made was implementing a more challenging rumor minigame and the hint button for everybody who needs the extra bit of help. ⭐



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/a162ff15fa515536e67876e4816c42cd6b65df1b.png"]

Over time, we added new Wanted Wall characters thanks to our original Kickstarter and our second Kickstarter, all about the official sticker set! 📜



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/db7f3dcc7bd07343017198a734c72412af3e9d6a.jpg"]

We implemented more monitor-dependent resolutions and added a monitor selection option in the settings menu. For anyone who has more than one monitor with different resolutions. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/a1193a8c9e5510a6bf52beeb57412c03a7fd99af.png"]

And we even got decorations for anybody with a wide-screen monitor! I mean, who wants to see black bars on their beautiful, wide monitor, am I right? 🖥️



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/720a64ba47541e828e325fefe60d03b810ac9ba4.png"]

Hot chocolate is Melina's favorite drink, and for some odd reason, in the days after release, she thought every drink was hot chocolate. Can't really blame her for that wishful thinking, right? Now she detects the hot chocolate just when she actually gets one. 🍫



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/99c901ad72f6e7fc12ad4623628b9fd5e1219040.png"]

Last but not least on the list of improvements - the Steam Deck! Tavern Talk was not only our first entertainment game, but also the first game we developed for the Steam Deck and Nintendo Switch! 

And while the UI was perfectly fine for your PC or TV, it wasn't quite enough for a smaller handheld device. Something we changed very swiftly to make it through Steam Deck verification! ✅



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/970c10934c38361ac9183aea043d6e231e9216a4.jpg"]



Let's move on to all the beautiful...


Features


We originally gave the alternative Fable Costume to all Kickstarter Supporters backing a copy of the game. Today, everybody owning the Supporter Edition Upgrade gains access to it! 🥰 This is one of our first features for the game, and the design was part of a vote on our Discord! It's completely community-powered!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/d152fa74cf13bb5ccee336b0030b7837768848ac.jpg"]



As mentioned before, we had something special planned for our dearest Streamers, and that was our Twitch integration! Enabling your chat to participate in your Tavern Talk streaming sessions in a more meaningful way! 🔴



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/18fbada37ac70a91c543d803c97917f4767f6e5e.png"]

Through certain commands, participants can vote on dialogue choices and drinks, and even pet Andu whenever you spend time in the drink mixing nook!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/67e85bf43d40bb919dceed2c4f2efd1aea95f997.png"]

The other feature we can no longer live without is the Fast-Forward button! With multiple endings, it soon became very clear that we needed to find a way to let you run through the game faster. 🛣️



And thanks to the Fast-Forward button on screen and the "remember dialogue" button in the settings, you can go through a second, third, and fourth run at the speed of light! 💫



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/293fbe07385f3bfd1dfc164870c73804dea896e1.gif"]



And one of our latest features is the Trinket Gallery and Zoom! The trinkets mean a lot to the story of Tavern Talk, but also to us because some of them are co-designed by our Kickstarter backers.



So giving them even more of a spotlight besides the lorebook and in-game appearance was something we anticipated for a long time, and eventually delivered this spring. 😻



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/c47b5747cfe7603c8350b3b280e9f9df8efaff13.png"]

The in-game zoom that the game now does every time you receive a trinket makes it extra special and fits into the game so well! This was also a suggestion made by the community. 💜



                                    [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/b2f9a36f544e1c103448226ce6f8b24fe4f07937.gif"]



One more section to go! 🤩


Events


Just like us, Tavern Talk and the world of Asteria are constantly changing, and things are just happening. And to symbolize this, we decided to implement seasonal events! For example, the Fall season. 🎃



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/47b06163b799fa09e27e2f61975fb4aae3e304bb.png"]

The cozy and freezing cold Winter season. ❄️



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/3233cbb6b99686bb940b73bcb7b06f9854d9f0dc.png"]

And right now, we have the Among Us crew running around causing chaos. This special seasonal event even comes with its own Twitch commands. 👀



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/fcfb06dec179a87f7a924267f6f13925d1d06686.png"]

Even if you are not in the mood for a specific season, we have you covered! We implemented a button in the main menu settings where you can turn the season on and off, however you like. 🫰



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/bae30f368cd3e69a77a9958461dc3e627cef367d.png"]



We learned a lot implementing all of these changes and plan to bring them all to Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker as well!



Speaking of which, if you want to be among the first to play the demo of Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker when it drops, sign up for our newsletter. Stay informed and grab some slick mobile phone wallpapers as a free gift as you go. 👀 



Sign up now

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/da4e9358dfcbe94b192e47d3f6eeb2b8bc21721c.png"]



That was quite a lot. I hope you all enjoyed this retrospective on Tavern Talk! Thank you for everything! 

Until then, stay safe 💜 Tommy

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/205677ffdade7c1d2ca5914602ec49db38077aca.png

Dear Innkeepers,

We're super hyped to share that we've been quietly working on a collaboration together with the beautiful people at Innersloth. 🥰 Today, we're proud to bring the Among Us crew to our little tavern in Asteria in an exciting seasonal free content update! 🔥

Until the end of June, the tiny space crew will wreak havoc in the Wayfarer's Inn. 
Some screens and events will look differently - for example, the bell used to complete drink mixing will be replaced with the emergency button sending not only magical drinks through the primordial vortex, but maybe even an imposter or two. 👀

[previewyoutube=PRZUECV47NA;full][/previewyoutube]

And there is more: To celebrate this update, we have put a heavy discount in place for Tavern Talk, its DLCs, and our bundles! 

Twitch commands are here!
If you're a streamer or content creator, there is more to get excited about: we have implemented Twitch commands, which your viewers can use in-chat. (If you need a quick reminder of how the Twitch integration works, read here!)

Once your account is connected, anyone in your chat can type in the command "!ttghost" to make an Among Us ghost appear under the counter, who will spook a crew member. 

[previewyoutube=y2WqAUWK7BA;full][/previewyoutube]

The other command is "!tthunt". A whole Among Us crew will pop up and start chasing each other over the screen.

[previewyoutube=UpyJu0JCNnc;full][/previewyoutube]

Turn seasonal events off in the settings

Not interested in any of this? No problem! If you are not in the mood for the Among Us shenanigans or any other seasonal event, there is now an option in the settings menu to turn them off entirely so you can enjoy the pure original Tavern Talk immersion.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/bae30f368cd3e69a77a9958461dc3e627cef367d.png

Seasonal events will happen throughout the year, but you can decide if you want to have them in your game.

Are you excited for our next outer-dimensional collab? The Among Us event starts right now and is available with the update dropped today!

Heavy discounts 💯

To celebrate this collaboration, we have discounted Tavern Talk by 30%! Our highest discount, yet, and we didn't stop there!

For the first time, our story DLC Tempest Tantrum has a 20% discount, and the  Supporter Upgrade got its first discount as well. It's 30% off as are the Lorebook, OST, P&P One Shot, Battlemaps, and Major Arcana Tarot Set.

So if you were looking at the bundles or just a DLC for you or a friend, now is the time! 🔥

And we are still not finished! In two days, we'll have another huge announcement for ya'll! 👀 If you want to be one of the first ones to get all the latest updates, giveaways & other special events, make sure to sign up for our newsletter. ⤵️

notes.title: Free Content Update For Base Game & Supporter Edition! 💯
notes.content:
Hey Innkeepers!

We've been listening to your wishes and now they're here – the new trinket features! 🤝 One of the most highly requested and anticipated features was giving the trinkets more attention when receiving them. It's amazing that you all enjoyed them so much that you wanted a closer look. 👀

We've thought about it for a while and decided to do this in two different ways. Firstly, when the patrons gift their trinkets to the innkeeper we are zooming in on them to celebrate the moment. This will also give you a good sense of what changed in your tavern. ✨

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/186a72b57a30043a7e73dd07cd3a40a0a0dca430.gif

Secondly, we've added a gallery where you can marvel at all the trinkets you've collected throughout the game. Moreover, every trinket comes with a note about which quest you obtained it from. 📜

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/f741427094e411ab65afe19b87ebf06f6e8fb0cc.jpg

We hope these additions cater to your collector's soul! Do you know what's best about it? You won't have to play through the game again. And maybe you want to start filling in the blanks – the gallery will tell you which trinkets are still waiting for you to find them. 😶‍🌫️

Already feeling the itch to set out and explore other branches of the plot? Trust us, this is where the Fast-Forward button will come in real handy. Here is how you activate it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/8db7dd7427b7f0bf6a532a49b0115242c6fde73d.png

notes.title: 🟣 Play with your community - Twitch Integration is here! 🟣

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/4a718e0794eeb2d1a8b9d8a6cb35cfbddd8b3482.png

Dear Innkeepers,

With our newest feature to the game you can bring your community into the Wayfarer's Inn! - Introducing Twitch Integration. We love how creative and wholesome content creators all over the world are! Seeing them and their community gave us the idea - let's have the chat decide what comes next.

The Twitch integration is only supported on Mac and Windows, not on Steam Deck. Since it is the first time we've implemented a feature like this we all hope you'll be patient with the process, if something doesn't work right away or needs to be changed.

But how does it work? We have a step-by-step instruction for you, but also if you need a more visual guide, here you go: 

[previewyoutube=CLOXz4Tc24c;full][/previewyoutube]

How to use the Twitch Integration

[olist]
 Go into your in-game settings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/970fb52082aa57c69b80580a6881e351e908afeb.jpg

 The tab on the far right shows a Twitch-Icon open it & click Authenticate. This will open a webpage, first asking you to enter a device code. This code should already be set.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/0994d1b260dab8ff34e9c26418446b42ebbae740.png

 After that you should be redirected to a page where you authorize the application to use your account to read the Twitch chat.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/15318668ede622016d47c8e71b124c7848c4b3ed.png

 Back in the game settings you should be authenticated and the user and channel name should be filled.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/6b63e0f55eb8964a74a93b6184ecbb91f1c53160.jpg

 User and channel names should be right in most cases, but if not you can edit them. In most cases both user name and channel name should be the same.

 The last thing is to connect with Twitch chat by pressing the connect button. This last step needs to be repeated everytime you launch Tavern Talk!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/919ea865b8923bb9f5f61278faee2248a18b96d2.jpg
[/olist]

 Now your community can vote whenever you have to make a decision or a quest drink. You just have to press the play button and each viewer gets one vote on the option.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/b69dbce5d3d73b7540af1b497a53742d513cd3b2.jpg

What viewers can do:


 Vote on specific dialog answers by writing 1, 2 or 3 in the chat 🗨️
 Vote on quest drinks by writing 1 or 2 in the chat 🍸
 Pet Andu via the command !pet andu 🥰


And that's all of it! We can't wait to see more streams and the funny situations that are coming with it!

We also have some bug fixes for you!

Bug fixes


 Quest creation breaks when switching between mouse & controller
 Visual and Audio fixes
 You can access the Sticker Kickstarter out of the load game screen with a controller

Our Story DLC: Tempest Tantrum is coming closer and closer! Mark the date in your calender - November 12th!

notes.title: Gotta go fast! - There is now a Fast-Forward button & less Swift Strike! 🏃‍♂️💨
notes.content:
The day has come! The Fast-Forward button is in the game!

Dear Innkeepers,

did you know Tavern Talk has three different endings and one additional secret ending? No? While we have read a few comments reflecting that choices don't seem to matter, they actually do. Especially in the long run over the entirety of the four acts – it may not be as noticeable in the first hours of the game. But trust, us, the drinks you brew and how you treat your patrons leave a mark on the path you take through Tavern Talk. 

Tavern Talk takes between 12 and 20 hours to complete a single run, so, now that you know, you may be wondering how you're supposed to see all of these endings without rereading each and every dialog bubble on every run. Well, some of you actually went all the way to do just that and we're mightily impressed by your effort! WOW! 😲 For those who couldn't bring themselves to do so, we have the bestest of news: 

Fast-Forward button to the rescue!

This patch brings a new button to your in-game UI you need to activate in the settings: the Fast-Forward button (see screenshot below). This button will have you jump super fast through dialog bubbles and halt at the next decision or drink-mixing for you to make.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/dd75ea2d8266eb18b602f8680d8fd7d72c6368c4.png

Again, please note that you need to activate the button in the settings in order to use this feature. We chose to do this since this feature doesn't make sense for people new to the game and we didn't want to clog the UI.

This feature alone should give you a big hand plowing through the content at the speed of light. But it gets even better:

Fast-Forward known dialog bubbles only!

While the game has no way of skipping bubbles you've read before this patch, because the game didn't track them, yet, it now starts tracking and offers an option to skip tracked dialog in future runs. This means that once you decide to rerun a certain section no matter which savegame you're playing you can activate the "Only skip read dialogs" checkbox in the settings (see screenshot below) to have the game speed run bubbles you know but go slow on the one's you haven't seen yet.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/8807883437993b8cb1375d0fd1705bc758e7bd39.png

IMPORTANT NOTE: if you're a Tavern Talk veteran and want to see the other endings, skipping known dialog won't work, yet, because tracking starts only now. Please go to the settings to activate the Fast-Forward button and make sure "Only skip read dialogs" is turned OFF! Since there is no tracked dialog to skip, yet, it would seem to you the Fast-Forward feature is broken, while it's not. You need to feed the tracker first by manually using the Fast-Forward feature for sections you already know. Once you have completed your first run, you can turn on the "Only skip read dialog" feature to make your life easier because it will then have data to work with. We understand it's not entirely convenient, but it was the only approach we could have implemented this feature post-release.

If you need a bit of help, here is a video tutorial for you: 

[previewyoutube=bQwJ9EPzV8Y;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope you appreciate the new Fast-Forward features and they will bring you joy in sunny breezing through the entirety of the Tavern Talk story without missing an outcome or dialog unknown to you. 💯

You can keep track of your previous playthroughs yourself or use the "100% Achievements Guide"-guide Magi752 has kindly provided here on Steam: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3274505211

That way you know exactly which dialog road you haven't traveled down, yet, which drink you need to make next, or which dialogue option you haven't chosen before.

Happy reruns, everyone! 💝 

Farewell Swift Strike mania! 👋

It became a meme in our community, that there were too many Swift Strike orders in the game and it became obvious we had to change that. And now we have! 🍹

While Swift Strike will remain Fable's favorite drink (we couldn't convince them otherwise) this patch introduces more varied drink requests at the Wayfarer's Inn and the game should not feel as repetitive anymore. 🎮  We had to rework some of the dialog for this, mainly because Swift Strike is the only dexterity-based drink in the early game and that remains a bit of a problem and isn't easily fixed.

So now, characters often ask for alternative drinks. Jade, for example, will now order an intelligence-based drink rather than a dexterity one and Fable wants to try out something new from time to time. 💚

Thanks to everyone hinting to this issue and that the game could use a little variety here and there so we could go and investigate. Some things simply get overlooked with development blinders stuck to our heads. 🫶

So let's order it one last time, shall we? A Swift Strike to go, please! 🍸

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/49f624b5e59e8d189f1f9a3f2f4c896d8af2539f.jpg

More secrets in the game 😲

Thanks to the amazing support on Kickstarter, we were able to implement a secret into the game and it has something to do with this Fable sticker on the main title screen. 👀

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/8597ec307b62edca58fa0d07f45d420b99c73fdc.png

Can you guess what it is? Let us know in the comments! 💜 

Roadmap update

We planned those changes a bit later in August, but made haste and finished them earlier than expected, thanks to our amazing team! We still have some improvements for the end of the year, so let us share the current state of the roadmap:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/8dac01139da215f0ce43fbf967b99df70aea34d2.png

As this journey continues, we  want to grow with all of you and make the Wayfarer's Inn cozier and better with each update. So thank you for sharing your improvement suggestions in the Steam Community Hub and our Discord server. ✨ This way we can engage easily, ask questions, offer transparent info on why we made certain decisions, or find solutions for reoccurring requests. We love to make Tavern Talk a better experience for you to enjoy and while we cannot implement each and every request out there we're always sensitive to things that come up frequently and align with our creative vision for the game.

notes.title: Bye bye color coding - Hello there hint-on-demand-button! 👀
notes.content:
Dear Innkeepers,

we're back with exciting news: we're putting the puzzle back into the rumor mini-game! 

We have heard your calls... 

... and with today's patch, rumor snippets that belong together will no longer look alike - except for random accidents, of course. We understand that the rumor mini-game as it shipped on release may have felt overly easy and unchallenging while the original demo suggested a more puzzly approach. So we made haste to find a suitable solution for all of you: to those who love themselves a good challenge and to those who just want to breeze through the story or who find the sheer amount of snippets in the later parts of the game overwhelming.

For those who want it easy, we have now added a new "hint-on-demand"-button that will appear should you fail putting together a quest for the first time. It is then up to you to use that button to ask the game for a hint about which snippets belong together. If you do, it will highlight all of the relevant snippets for the current round of quest-making. If several quests need to be found, the game won't tell you which snippets belong together, but since it will allow you to focus on a clear sub-set of rumors we are sure you will manage. 

If you belong to the first group and prefer to rack your brain given no clues at all simply ignore that button and go for it! This is what it now looks like in the game: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/a162ff15fa515536e67876e4816c42cd6b65df1b.png

We're quite happy with the solution we found here and we hope you feel the same. May it let you all enjoy the game even more! We will update the demo with this big adjustment, as well, so it also shows the updated gameplay.

Now, let's have a look at the other improvements and fixes this patch brings with it:

Improvements & Bug fixes


 Expose monitor-dependent resolutions and add a monitor selection option:  You can now select the resolutions fitting to your monitor. Do you have a 4k screen? No Problem. Or maybe a widescreen? We've got you covered! Even if you have a second screen plugged into your machine, you can now choose which screen the game should be displayed on. If you should encounter any issues with this, please get in touch through the support link on our Steam page. 🖥️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/e452696b07ce4354decc1b4a66bdf1723dd26742.png

 Added some SFXs missing for controller inputs ... to give you an even more immersive experience.  🎮
 Added new names to the guestbook entries & updated names for the Credits Kickstarter backer: Some names in the credits and in the guestbook entries were still missing. Digging in we found there was quite a hiccup in our export. Sorry for that! We're confident we finally fixed it for good. All backers who wanted to be named should appear in the credits now.  ✅
 Fixed typos in German: Thanks to your keen eyes we found more typos in the German translation. It's a bit ironic since we're a studio from Germany, we know. We should have done more aufpassen in the Schule back in the day! We cleaned everything up and it should be a way smoother read now. Dangefön! 🫶
 Melina now detects HOT CHOCOLATE just when she actually gets one: Hot chocolate is Melina's favorite drink and for some reason, she thought every drink was hot chocolate. Can't really blame her for that wishful thinking, right? 🍫
 Fixed some pronoun issues: Some pronoun variables got mixed up, so we fixed them! 😊


Glimpse into the (near) future

That's a wrap concerning today's patch! But we have more changes lined up for the near future and on the remote horizon so we decided to give you a tiny roadmap for what's coming up:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/bcd57225a3d0fb9e57f7f6acc5e67d953773c691.png

As always, thank you for  your feedback and suggestions through the reviews and the discussions on  the Community Hub and of course in our Discord! We love to look for ways to improve our debut game based on your feedback as we continue to grow as a studio and as a community. Thank you for your engagement and for being a part of this journey! 💜

Keep the suggestions coming!

Until next time, 
Tommy

Hey there Innkeepers,

First of all we want to thank you all from the bottom of our collected hearts! As of this moment, we have over 566 reviews, this is simply incredible. Thank you all for taking the time and leaving your thoughts behind, helping us to make Tavern Talk even better. 💜

With this announcement, we want to show you, that we are listening to your suggestions and trying to implement them into the game to the best of our abilities. Thank you all for being so supportive of this journey and being a part of it all. Tavern Talk is a game that is surrounded by a loving community and we can feel that every day.

notes.title: WDC World Ocean Day Charity Sale
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that we are supporting WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation for World Ocean Day!   

The WDC World Ocean Day Sale starts today and runs until 15th June, 10am PDT 2024!
With every game you buy and that is part of the event, a certain percentage of the profit goes to WDC to support their conservation work.

Who is WDC?

WDC, Whale and Dolphin conservation is the leading global charity dedicated to the protection and conservation of whales and dolphins. 

Their expert-led teams in the UK, Europe, the Americas, and Australasia work across the whole spectrum of threats, from climate breakdown to accidental entanglements in fishing gear. They bring together, and work hand-in-hand with, businesses, philanthropists, scientists, NGOs, governments and grassroots communities to find solutions to the problems faced by whales and dolphins.
Their aim is to reverse the global decline in whale and dolphin populations by creating safe seas for these majestic creatures.

Entanglement in fishing gear, or ‘bycatch’ as it’s known, is the biggest threat whales and dolphins face. Many hundreds of thousands die in nets or get tangled up in fishing gear every year. As air-breathing mammals like us, when they get trapped in a net, panic can take over and they can sustain terrible injuries before either escaping, or suffocating. It is a massive problem and so WDC are working on some innovative solutions.  

What WDC has been doing so far 

WDC have been working across the globe to protect whales, dolphins and porpoises from dying in fishing gear: 


 They’re collaborating with creel fishers in Scotland to trial new types of fishing gear to reduce entanglements of humpback and minke whales. 
 They’re working with colleagues and partner organisations in the Central Baltic Sea to develop a recovery plan for a critically endangered group of Baltic harbour porpoises. 
 On the west coast of the United States, critically endangered North Atlantic right whales are facing extinction. Entanglement is a massive threat to their survival, and WDC have been working with fishers to trial alternative gear types. 
 In Hong Kong WDC have been supporting local community efforts and working with fishers to save the remaining 200 Indo-Pacific finless porpoises from extinction due to bycatch.   


These projects are saving lives, and they are powered by inspiring people working together for the ocean. 

How your support will help this year

By purchasing games from this year’s World Ocean Day sale, you will help WDC continue these vital conservation projects across the globe, as well as enable WDC’s team to embark on new efforts to bring further protections for whales and dolphins, like the Sri Lankan gillnet fisheries project: 


 Sri Lanka is home to many species of whales, dolphins and porpoises as well as a myriad of other sensitive marine species like sea turtles that are vulnerable to entanglement in gillnets – these are nets that hang in the water like a wall. With funding, WDC hopes to collaborate with Sri Lankan artisanal tuna fisheries that use gillnets to trial new gear types and reduce the impact their fishing has on marine life, while still enabling them to earn their living. 


Whales and dolphins are awe-inspiring. They are intelligent beings, vital for the health of the ocean and planet. Together we can still help them recover and flourish and they can help us reconnect with the wild, and repair the damage we have caused
. 
If you want to read more about WDC, you can do so here: https://whales.org/ 

Keep up to date with all the awesome gaming activities WDC does here: https://games.whales.org/ 

And you can find many other amazing games in the sale here: https://bit.ly/WODSteamSale24 

We'll be also running our Broadcast of the final version of Tavern Talk during the Event. So make sure to check it our and say hi. 💜

Cheers,
Tommy

A slider lets you gradually adjust text speed adjusting it perfectly to your personal reading speed! That way you can customize how fast your Patrons talk to you. So, if you'd like to tune down speed to up the cozy feel ... you're welcome! Or if you want to make it faster, because you are on your 111th playthrough, we've got you covered! 👍

But the settings and screens are not the only things that have changed. 👀

🛠️ Renovation time! 🛠️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/708b133341f961269fa598f7cda8fbc80dd7dd0d.png

The new Tavern background
Can you spot the differences? And more importantly, can you spot all the easter eggs we have already hidden in this screenshot? 👁️

With the new Trinkets being added to the game and the cool in-game camera zooms (remember that stretch goal from the campaign?), some things had to be rearranged in the Tavern. 🧹

But we also added and polished more details in the background, to give the Wayfarer's Inn a more lifed-in feel! You know what they say, the cozier, the better! 💕

What do you think of the new additions so far? Leave us a comment here or in our Discord. 💜 

Next time we will show you some of the fancy tarot cards currently in the making and even more wonderful additions to the game! Stay tuned for our Tavern Spotlight! 🔍

Cheers,
Tommy

notes.title: Upcoming features and updates for Tavern Talk 01/04/2024
notes.content:
We have some amazing updates for you! These improvements will be part of the final game and will help in the long run to give you the best version of Tavern Talk.

- Andu is no longer in the game. 💨

We found out that Andu took a lot of the overall processing power of the game and to combat that we decided to remove them from the game entirely. There is still Andu's bucket, so just use your imagination. Theater of the Mind is an important part of D&D!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/b5eb8ada10afca810730b52a266b50bb8a416faf.png

- We made the text smaller. 🤏

The story of Tavern Talk got so immense that we decided to shrink the text, so we can give you more on each text bubble! It's harder to read, but we are sure you have glasses at home.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/cf312a9afa2f0ecd063af12eef754f0da2187801.jpg

- The text speed is now even slower 🦥

You heard that right. To give you the chance to read everything word by word and not to miss anything!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/4c557cffbd98cbec41583bdf30f743e77d9b2a4d.jpg

- Each in-game day will be a DLC! 🫰

This way the Tavern fun will last longer. Yeah, some days are only 10-20 minutes long, but if we release every week, you don't have to wait so long to get the full experience in the end. And in only 40 Weeks (each day costing about 2€) you will have the full story. It is just like waiting for your favorite anime.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/736dae1fb524e6a2487dafc34504facc49143ecf.jpg

- You can play Tavern Talk exactly once! 💯

We always said it is Coffee Talk meets D&D and to focus more on the D&D aspect of the game, we decided that you can play Tavern Talk exactly once. After you finish the game, your file will be corrupted preventing you from playing it again. Making all your decisions permanent, just like in D&D! This feature links directly to your Steam Account. Deleting and re-installing won't do the trick and would be cheating anyway. If you want to try it again, to get a different outcome, you can always make a new Steam Account and buy it again, I guess. Tavern Talk is now officially the Dark Souls of Visual Novel Games!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/a963df2d7822d00f0486a82e18afd078fe23f74c.jpg

- Controller Input will be a thing 🎮

Some people like it more than playing with a mouse and keyboard.

- Major performance improvement 💪

Just like Andu, we noticed that one flying particle in the Tavern was causing the game to crash. We removed it. You are welcome.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/99ca7370d25030579641fbd8db88cf32be3cfe58.jpg

I hope you enjoyed this glimpse into the future of gaming! Have a great April (April started just now, right? Sorry, I am a silly fool) and see you soon. 💜
